summary.title: Clouds Against Humanity: pipeline mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
summary.description: Same data flow diagram and trust boundaries as the STRIDE model (clouds-against-humanity.threat-dragon.json), with each threat re-written to cite MITRE ATT&CK techniques (Enterprise matrix, IaaS platform, v20.0). Threat Dragon has no ATT&CK threat type: the technique is in the threat title and description, and the STRIDE category in the type field is kept. Only threats that describe adversary behaviour are kept; the Repudiation threats have no ATT&CK technique and are left out. T-numbers match docs/wiki/Threat-Model.md. A model records what someone believes; it does not verify the system. Generic names only.

diagrams.title: Contributor to protected resource (ATT&CK mapped)
diagrams.description: Contributor and maintainer through the repository, CI, Spacelift, Doppler and the cloud API to the connector droplets and Twingate.

data.name: Internet scanner (A1)
data.description: A1: an anonymous party on the internet with no account. Scans for open ports and exposed services.

threats.title: T1595.001 Scanning IP Blocks: Scanner pretends to be a legitimate client
threats.description: T1: an anonymous party tries to talk to a connector as if it were a client. ATT&CK v20.0: T1595.001 Scanning IP Blocks [TA0043 Reconnaissance]; T1133 External Remote Services [TA0003 Persistence, TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: There is nothing to talk to: zero public inbound rules, connectors are outbound-only. Detection: a firewall or host log; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built). The B1 control is that there is nothing to find.

data.name: Contributor (A2)
data.description: Full name: Contributor or fork author (A2). A2: someone who can propose code through a pull request but cannot push or merge.

data.name: Upstream publishers
data.description: Full name: Upstream publishers (actions, Doppler CLI, apt repos). Supply chain: the publishers of pinned CI actions, the Doppler CLI release, the Twingate apt repository and Ubuntu mirrors.

threats.title: T1195.002 Compromise Software Supply Chain: Tampered download or action
threats.description: T7, T8, T9: a compromised action, CLI binary or package is pulled into the pipeline or onto a droplet. ATT&CK v20.0: T1195.002 Compromise Software Supply Chain [TA0001 Initial Access]; T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools [TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Actions pinned by commit SHA; Doppler CLI pinned by SHA-256 (fail closed); Twingate apt key checked against a pinned fingerprint; apt verifies signatures. Residual: a pinned commit that was already malicious. Detection: a changed pin in a pull request diff, not a runtime log. Review the diff of any pin change.

data.name: Maintainer (A3/A4)
data.description: Full name: Maintainer and laptop (A3 / A4). A3: whoever can push to main (one writer today). A4: a stolen maintainer identity (Twingate sign-in plus SSH key). Holds the Twingate client and the SSH key.

threats.title: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts: Maintainer identity or session stolen
threats.description: T2: stolen Twingate credentials. Together with the SSH key this gives a shell on a connector. The exercise notes there is no numbered threat for takeover of the maintainer's own accounts. ATT&CK v20.0: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access]; T1621 Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Sign-in delegated to the identity provider (enforce MFA there; not visible in this repository); SSH key still required. Verify account hardening in each vendor console. Detection: the identity provider and GitHub sign-in and audit logs, if the plan includes them (check).

threats.title: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts: Anyone who can push to main is trusted
threats.description: T3: the design assumes one writer. A second writer, or a taken-over writer account, makes pull request and tracked-run attacks real. ATT&CK v20.0: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access]; T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: Branch protection, one writer, required reviews before adding a second writer. Settings live outside the repository: verify by hand. Detection: GitHub audit log of pushes to main and branch protection changes (a vendor log; check the plan).

data.name: Source repo
data.description: Full name: Source repository and main branch. Public repository, branch protection on main, CI green required. Holds code and the pipeline definition. Holds no cloud credential.

threats.title: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution: Malicious change to the secrets hook or .spacelift/config.yml
threats.description: T3: a change makes the hook print the Doppler token. Every automated check can pass a few changed lines. ATT&CK v20.0: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution]; T1072 Software Deployment Tools [TA0002 Execution, TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: Push policy never proposes a run; CI holds no cloud credential; branch protection; a person reads the diff. Detection: the pull request diff on the secrets hook or the stack config; a Spacelift run history entry.

threats.title: T1593.003 Code Repositories: Operator identifiers leak through the public repository
threats.description: T14: account ids, address ranges, names or machine identifiers end up in a commit, doc or issue. ATT&CK v20.0: T1593.003 Code Repositories [TA0043 Reconnaissance]; T1589 Gather Victim Identity Information [TA0043 Reconnaissance].
threats.mitigation: Identifiers live in Doppler; SSH key comment stripped; secret scanning in CI. Residual: human error in a commit message or doc. Detection: secret scanning and the identifier check in CI before merge; after merge, only an outside report.

data.name: CI (GitHub Actions)
data.description: Runs pytest, the cost gate and tofu test on pull request code. permissions: {} by default; no cloud credential.

threats.title: T1552 Unsecured Credentials: Hostile test prints a secret
threats.description: T3, T7: a pull request's code runs in CI and tries to read or print a secret. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552 Unsecured Credentials [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: CI holds no cloud credential, so there is nothing to read. Worst case is wasted minutes. Detection: the CI run log, read by a human or a secret scanner.

threats.title: T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools: Compromised action runs in CI
threats.description: T7: a pinned action is malicious or its pin is moved. ATT&CK v20.0: T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools [TA0001 Initial Access]; T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: Every action pinned by commit SHA; permissions: {} by default. Residual: a compromised pinned commit is trusted until the pin changes. Detection: a CI run behaving differently after a pin change; egress logs if you had them.

data.name: Spacelift proposed run
data.description: Full name: Spacelift proposed run (pull request). A plan-only run. The push policy never proposes one, so no pull request code should run here. If one does start, the cah-doppler context is attached to every run type and exposes DOPPLER_TOKEN to it; only the unmodified hook skips fetching the named secrets (docs/spacelift-secrets.md, section 8).

threats.title: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution: A pull request becomes a run next to the secrets
threats.description: T3: until the push policy is attached in Spacelift, a same-repository pull request that changes a stack still gets a proposed run, and the hook script is read from the pull request's branch. ATT&CK v20.0: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: Attach .spacelift/policies/push.rego in Spacelift (paid plan) or narrow project roots and globs (free plan); nobody else opens pull requests until then. Verify in the console. Detection: a Spacelift proposed run on a pull request when none should exist.

data.name: Spacelift tracked run
data.description: Full name: Spacelift tracked run (main). Runs plan and apply for a stack from main. Holds DOPPLER_TOKEN and the per-stack secrets loaded in before_init. Apply waits for a human confirm.

threats.title: T1555.006 Cloud Secrets Management Stores: A compromised tracked run reaches every prd secret
threats.description: T3, T4, T10: code that executes during init or plan runs before the confirm gate, with DOPPLER_TOKEN scoped to the whole prd config. The per-stack secret list is not isolation. ATT&CK v20.0: T1555.006 Cloud Secrets Management Stores [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1528 Steal Application Access Token [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Gates before main: pull request, CI green, branch protection, one writer. The confirm gate reviews the plan, it does not stop code that already ran. Detection: the secrets provider's access log for the service token, if the plan includes one (check).

threats.title: T1072 Software Deployment Tools: Apply of a plan nobody reviewed
threats.description: T11: autodeploy applies a bad plan. ATT&CK v20.0: T1072 Software Deployment Tools [TA0002 Execution, TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: Autodeploy off; a person confirms every apply; cost gate and approved totals in review. Detection: the Spacelift audit trail of who confirmed which run.

threats.title: T1496.001 Compute Hijacking: Resources outside the repository run up the bill
threats.description: T11: spend from resources created outside the repository or bandwidth overage is not covered by the cost gate. ATT&CK v20.0: T1496.001 Compute Hijacking [TA0040 Impact]; T1578.002 Create Cloud Instance [TA0112 Defense Impairment].
threats.mitigation: Billing alerts at $10 and $25. Residual: check the cloud account for undeclared resources. Detection: the provider's billing alerts and an inventory of resources the code does not declare.

data.name: OpenTofu state
data.description: Full name: OpenTofu state in Spacelift. State holds connector tokens and the full resource map. Stored only in Spacelift.

threats.title: T1552 Unsecured Credentials: Connector token read out of state
threats.description: T6: anyone who can read stack state sees the connector tokens. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552 Unsecured Credentials [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1213 Data from Information Repositories [TA0009 Collection].
threats.mitigation: Marked sensitive; state lives only in Spacelift. Accepted: restrict state access in Spacelift. Detection: the state backend's access log, if the vendor offers one (check).

data.name: Doppler prd config
data.description: Every runtime secret: cloud token, Twingate API token, tenant name, admin key name and user ids. Read through a read-only, single-config service token.

threats.title: T1552 Unsecured Credentials: Doppler service token leaks
threats.description: T4: the service token reads all prd secrets until revoked. Nothing records who read the config. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552 Unsecured Credentials [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1528 Steal Application Access Token [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1555.006 Cloud Secrets Management Stores [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Read-only, one config, 90-day expiry, write-only in Spacelift, masked in logs. Rotate every value it could read, not only the token. Detection: the secrets provider's activity log for reads from an unexpected place or time (check the plan).

threats.title: T1199 Trusted Relationship: Vendor compromise or outage
threats.description: T10: a hosted control plane is compromised or unavailable. ATT&CK v20.0: T1199 Trusted Relationship [TA0001 Initial Access]; T1195 Supply Chain Compromise [TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Accepted: inherent to using hosted control planes. Detection: the vendor's own incident notices; nothing you collect.

data.name: Cloud provider API
data.description: The provider API that creates droplets and firewalls. Reached with a write-scoped token.

threats.title: T1496.001 Compute Hijacking: Runaway bill through the provider API
threats.description: T11: an unreviewed or malicious apply creates expensive resources. ATT&CK v20.0: T1496.001 Compute Hijacking [TA0040 Impact]; T1578.002 Create Cloud Instance [TA0112 Defense Impairment].
threats.mitigation: Cost gate allowlist of free resource types; approved totals; billing alerts at $10 and $25. Detection: provider audit events for droplet creation, and billing alerts at the set thresholds.

threats.title: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts: Write token can open anything in the account
threats.description: T10: a stolen write token can create, destroy or open anything in the account. ATT&CK v20.0: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Custom scopes limited to droplets, firewalls and tags; token held only by Spacelift runs. Accepted vendor trust. Detection: provider audit events for API calls made with the write token.

data.name: Twingate
data.description: Full name: Twingate controller and relay. Hosted zero-trust control plane. Signs the maintainer in through the identity provider and enforces per-resource access.

threats.title: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts: Stolen Twingate credentials
threats.description: T2: an attacker presents the maintainer's identity to Twingate. ATT&CK v20.0: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access]; T1621 Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Sign-in delegated to the identity provider (MFA there); access limited to one host and port per resource; SSH key still required. Detection: the ZTNA vendor's sign-in log and the identity provider's log.

threats.title: T1199 Trusted Relationship: Vendor compromise
threats.description: T10: the control plane is compromised. ATT&CK v20.0: T1199 Trusted Relationship [TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Narrow scopes; end-to-end encryption to connectors; separate SSH key gate. Accepted. Detection: the vendor's incident notices; connector logs for unexpected sessions.

data.name: Connector droplets
data.description: Full name: Connector droplets (two). Two outbound-only connector droplets. No public inbound rules. Hold their connector token in a root-only file.

threats.title: T1552.005 Cloud Instance Metadata API: Connector token readable via the metadata endpoint
threats.description: T5: user-data is readable by any local process through the metadata endpoint. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552.005 Cloud Instance Metadata API [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Token file is root-only 0600; one token per connector, revocable. Accepted: lockdown is a follow-up. Detection: a read of the metadata endpoint by an unexpected process; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built).

threats.title: T1489 Service Stop: Both connectors down, operator locked out
threats.description: T13: no console password by design. ATT&CK v20.0: T1489 Service Stop [TA0040 Impact]; T1499 Endpoint Denial of Service [TA0040 Impact].
threats.mitigation: Two connectors with staggered reboots and updates. Accepted: recovery is a rebuild through Spacelift. Detection: the connector going offline in the ZTNA console and an uptime check on the access path.

threats.title: T1021.004 SSH: Lateral movement between droplets
threats.description: T12: a compromised droplet moves to another. ATT&CK v20.0: T1021.004 SSH [TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: Provider firewalls: inbound only from the firewall's own tag, no address rules; tests pin the exact set. Detection: SSH and sudo events in the journal; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built).

threats.title: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application: Exposed service exploited from the internet
threats.description: T1: scanning, brute force or exploit of an exposed service. ATT&CK v20.0: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application [TA0001 Initial Access]; T1133 External Remote Services [TA0003 Persistence, TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Zero public inbound rules attached by tag at creation; sshd keys only, one user. Detection: service logs on the host; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built). The control is that nothing listens publicly.

data.name: Protected resources
data.description: Full name: Protected resources (SSH on a private host). What Twingate exposes: one host and one port per resource (TCP 22). Placeholder for whatever later sits behind a connector.

threats.title: T1078 Valid Accounts: Identity plus SSH key together give a shell
threats.description: T2: an attacker with both the identity and the SSH key gets a shell. Stage 2 would make this a foothold with a path home. ATT&CK v20.0: T1078 Valid Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access]; T1021.004 SSH [TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: One host and port per resource; sshd allows only the admin user with a key. Stage 2 needs its own Twingate group and service account. Detection: a login at an unexpected time in the SSH journal; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built).

data.name: Blocked inbound traffic
data.description: Full label: Unsolicited inbound traffic (blocked). Port scans and connection attempts from the internet. Nothing is listening: no inbound rules.

threats.title: T1110 Brute Force: Flood or brute force against a connector
threats.description: T1: unsolicited traffic aimed at the droplets. ATT&CK v20.0: T1110 Brute Force [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1498 Network Denial of Service [TA0040 Impact].
threats.mitigation: Zero public inbound rules; connectors are outbound-only. Detection: firewall drop counts or connector logs; none is collected today.

data.name: Fork pull request
data.description: Full label: Fork pull request (code, no secrets). Proposed code. No credentials cross this flow in either direction.

threats.title: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution: Pull request edits the pipeline
threats.description: T3: the pull request changes scripts, workflows or stack definitions. ATT&CK v20.0: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: CI only; branch protection; review of the changed-file list. Detection: the pull request diff on workflow files.

data.name: PR code checkout
data.description: Full label: Pull request code checkout (code). CI checks out the pull request code and runs repository code on it.

threats.title: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution: Pull request code runs with CI permissions
threats.description: T3, T7: hostile repository code runs in CI. ATT&CK v20.0: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: permissions: {} by default; no cloud credential in CI. Detection: the CI run log and the workflow permissions block in the diff.

data.name: CI status check
data.description: Full label: CI green status check (build result). The CI result that branch protection requires before merge.

data.name: Action refs by SHA
data.description: Full label: Action refs resolved by commit SHA (code). Third-party action code fetched at a pinned commit.

threats.title: T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools: Action pin moved to malicious code
threats.description: T7: the pinned reference changes or the pinned commit was already malicious. ATT&CK v20.0: T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools [TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Pin by full commit SHA; review pin changes. Detection: a pin change in a diff; a tag that moved is invisible if you pin by tag, which is why the repository pins by commit.

data.name: Review and merge
data.description: Full label: Review and merge (approval, code). The maintainer reviews the diff and merges to main. The only path to a tracked run.

data.name: PR push event
data.description: Full label: Pull request push event (commit ref; policy decides). Webhook telling Spacelift about a pull request branch. The push policy should answer: never propose.

threats.title: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution: Policy missing: pull request starts a proposed run
threats.description: T3: without the push policy attached, a same-repository pull request gets a proposed run. A fork starts nothing unless a policy defines allow_fork. ATT&CK v20.0: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution].
threats.mitigation: Attach the push policy in Spacelift; it is not read from the repository. Detection: a Spacelift proposed run on a pull request, in the run history.

data.name: Merged commit
data.description: Full label: Merged commit on main (code). The commit a tracked run will plan and apply.

threats.title: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution: Malicious change merged to main
threats.description: T3: anyone who can push to main is trusted. ATT&CK v20.0: T1677 Poisoned Pipeline Execution [TA0002 Execution]; T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Accepted: pull request, CI green, branch protection, one writer. Detection: the merge in repository history; review is the control, not detection.

data.name: Doppler CLI download
data.description: Full label: Doppler CLI download (binary). The pinned Doppler CLI release fetched by the secrets hook.

threats.title: T1195.002 Compromise Software Supply Chain: Tampered Doppler CLI
threats.description: T8: a modified binary runs next to the secrets. ATT&CK v20.0: T1195.002 Compromise Software Supply Chain [TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Pinned version and SHA-256 per architecture; mismatch deletes the file and stops the run. Detection: a checksum mismatch in the install step, which fails closed.

data.name: Service token read
data.description: Full label: Read request with service token (DOPPLER_TOKEN). The run presents the read-only service token and asks for secrets by name.

threats.title: T1552 Unsecured Credentials: Service token appears in a log
threats.description: T4: the token or a fetched value is printed in a run log. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552 Unsecured Credentials [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Each fetched value is masked with ::add-mask; whether masking works on a real run was still to be confirmed. Detection: the run log, found by a person or a secret scanner.

threats.title: T1550.001 Application Access Token: Stolen service token used to ask Doppler for secrets
threats.description: T4: Doppler decides who is asking by one token, so whoever holds it is treated as the run. ATT&CK v20.0: T1550.001 Application Access Token [TA0008 Lateral Movement]; T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Read-only token, scoped to one config, 90-day expiry; revoke on suspicion. Detection: the secrets provider's activity log for reads from an unexpected place (check the plan).

data.name: Secrets returned
data.description: Full label: Secrets (cloud token, Twingate API token, tenant, admin key). Secret values returned to the run and loaded into the environment before the plan.

threats.title: T1552 Unsecured Credentials: Secrets read in transit or by run code
threats.description: T4: any code that executes in the run can read the environment. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552 Unsecured Credentials [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1555.006 Cloud Secrets Management Stores [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: TLS to Doppler; masking; gates before main. Detection: nothing records what code in a run read; that is why it stays Open.

data.name: State and tokens
data.description: Full label: OpenTofu state (connector tokens, resource map). State written and read by the run.

threats.title: T1552 Unsecured Credentials: State readable by anyone with stack access
threats.description: T6: connector tokens sit in state. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552 Unsecured Credentials [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Marked sensitive; restrict state access in Spacelift. Accepted. Detection: the state backend's access log, if the vendor offers one (check).

data.name: Plan for review
data.description: Full label: Plan for review (resource changes). The plan a human reads before confirming.

data.name: Human confirms apply
data.description: Full label: Confirm apply (human approval). The single human gate between plan and apply.

data.name: Apply with cloud token
data.description: Full label: Apply: create or destroy droplets and firewalls (cloud token). Provider API calls made with the write-scoped token after confirm.

data.name: Create droplet
data.description: Full label: Droplet create with user-data (connector token). Cloud-init carries the connector token to the droplet.

threats.title: T1552.005 Cloud Instance Metadata API: Token in user-data
threats.description: T5, T6: the connector token travels in user-data and sits in state. ATT&CK v20.0: T1552.005 Cloud Instance Metadata API [TA0006 Credential Access].
threats.mitigation: Root-only file; revocable per connector. Accepted. Detection: provider audit events for the droplet create call; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built) for reads.

data.name: Twingate API call
data.description: Full label: Twingate API: resources, connectors, tokens (API token). The run uses the Read, Write and Provision key to create connectors and issue tokens.

threats.title: T1098.001 Additional Cloud Credentials: Stolen API key creates its own connector
threats.description: T4: whoever holds the Twingate key can create a connector or issue tokens for an existing one. ATT&CK v20.0: T1098.001 Additional Cloud Credentials [TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation]; T1136.003 Cloud Account [TA0003 Persistence].
threats.mitigation: After a leak, rotate the key and look in the console for connectors the code does not declare. Detection: the ZTNA vendor's audit log for a new connector or key. ATT&CK has no technique named for a rogue ZTNA connector; these two are the closest fit.

data.name: IdP sign-in
data.description: Full label: IdP sign-in and resource request (identity). The maintainer signs in through the identity provider and requests one resource.

threats.title: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts: Identity replayed or phished
threats.description: T2: stolen credentials or session. ATT&CK v20.0: T1078.004 Cloud Accounts [TA0005 Stealth, TA0003 Persistence, TA0004 Privilege Escalation, TA0001 Initial Access]; T1621 Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation [TA0006 Credential Access]; T1550.001 Application Access Token [TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: MFA at the identity provider; per-resource ACL. Detection: the identity provider's sign-in log (impossible travel, repeated MFA prompts).

data.name: Outbound connector link
data.description: Full label: Outbound connector link (connector token). The connector dials out to Twingate and presents its token. Nothing dials in to the droplet.

threats.title: T1550.001 Application Access Token: Stolen connector token used to impersonate a connector
threats.description: T5: a token taken from the droplet or state is presented elsewhere. ATT&CK v20.0: T1550.001 Application Access Token [TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: One token per connector; revocable. Detection: two connectors with the same identity in the ZTNA console.

data.name: Relayed session
data.description: Full label: Relayed session (user traffic). Authorised user traffic, carried to the connector over the link the connector opened. One direction in the diagram: Twingate to the droplet.

data.name: SSH to resource
data.description: Full label: SSH to the protected resource (TCP 22, key required). The only traffic Twingate admits.

threats.title: T1021.004 SSH: Move from one droplet to another
threats.description: T12: lateral movement. ATT&CK v20.0: T1021.004 SSH [TA0008 Lateral Movement].
threats.mitigation: Firewall admits only connector-to-connector SSH by tag. Detection: SSH events between the droplets in the journal; no host or cloud log is collected today (stage 2 is designed, not built).

data.name: Signed apt packages
data.description: Full label: Signed packages (apt repo, pinned key). Twingate and Ubuntu packages installed at first boot.

threats.title: T1195.002 Compromise Software Supply Chain: Tampered Twingate package
threats.description: T9: a modified package installs on a connector. ATT&CK v20.0: T1195.002 Compromise Software Supply Chain [TA0001 Initial Access].
threats.mitigation: Key checked against a pinned fingerprint; apt verifies signatures. Detection: apt signature failures at install time, which fail closed.

data.name: B1: no inbound
data.description: Nothing from the internet may reach a connector droplet. Zero public inbound rules.

data.name: B2: PR, CI only
data.description: A stranger's pull request reaches the repository and CI only, with no credentials.

label.text: B3: push policy never proposes a Spacelift run

data.name: B3: push policy never proposes a Spacelift run
data.description: Pull request code must not start a Spacelift run. The policy lives in Spacelift, not in the repository.

data.name: B4: branch protection + CI green
data.description: The only path to main. Branch protection is a setting outside the repository.

data.name: B5: tracked run on main
data.description: Only a merged commit on main becomes a tracked run.

label.text: B6: read-only token, fetched by name

data.name: B6: read-only token, fetched by name
data.description: Doppler to Spacelift: read-only service token scoped to the one prd config.

data.name: B7: human confirms apply
data.description: Spacelift to the cloud API: apply waits for a person.

data.name: B8: IdP sign-in, per-resource ACL
data.description: Maintainer to Twingate: identity provider sign-in and one host and port per resource.
